label: Carousel
desc: A plain, accessible slide carousel with previous/next buttons, pagination, arrow/Home/End keys, swipe or drag, optional autoplay that pauses on hover and focus, and one to four slides per view.
use: Featured content, product or case-study slides, testimonials (give it a height or an aspect ratio).

label: Circular carousel
desc: Cards on a wheel of which only the top arc shows; the chosen card sits at the top, larger and brighter. Drag to spin, click a card, buttons and arrow keys.
use: Picking one of 6 to 16 options visually: destinations, templates, team members.

label: Circular gallery
desc: A 3D cylinder of picture panels that turns slowly by itself; drag to spin with inertia and settle on a panel; pauses on hover and focus.
use: Portfolio or album showcase on a landing page (fills its parent).

label: Depth carousel
desc: A deck of cards in 3D: the front card is sharp, the ones behind step back, shrink and soften; swipe, click a card behind or use the buttons and keys.
use: Featured stories, release notes or case studies where order matters.

label: Dome gallery
desc: Pictures on the inside of a dome: look around by dragging (with inertia), move tile to tile with the arrow keys, click a tile to bring it to the centre.
use: An immersive gallery section or event recap (fills its parent).

label: Drift wall
desc: A tilted wall of tiles whose columns drift up and down endlessly at different speeds; stops on hover and focus, has a pause button, still under reduced motion.
use: Hero backdrop or social-proof wall of work, customers or photos.

label: Flex carousel
desc: A row of picture panels where one is open and captioned and the others are slim strips, swapping with flex-grow; stacks vertically in narrow containers.
use: Compact feature or destination picker (3 to 8 panels).

label: Flying posters
desc: Posters fly out of the distance toward you through a 3D tunnel; the pointer steers, hovering freezes it, speed buttons and keys; holds still under reduced motion.
use: Event, film or launch teaser sections (fills its parent).

label: Infinite spiral
desc: Pictures laid along a spiral that winds into the centre and flow outward and grow as they near you, forever; drag, buttons, keys, click to bring one forward.
use: A playful gallery or archive teaser (fills its parent).

label: Masonry
desc: Tiles of different heights packed into responsive columns by shortest-column placement, with reveal-on-scroll, hover captions and optional selection.
use: Photo walls, inspiration boards and portfolio grids (scrolls inside its frame).

label: Scroll stack
desc: Cards that pile up as you scroll: each sticks near the top while the next slides over it and the covered ones shrink and dim; includes a card navigator.
use: Step-by-step explainers and process sections (scrolls inside its frame).
